claim.claim-text: 1. A yogurt analog food product, comprising:

a. particles of a filamentous fungus belonging to an order selected from the group consisting of Mucorales, Ustilaginales, Russulales, Polyporales, Agaricales, Pezizales and Hypocreales, wherein the filamentous fungus: comprises greater than 40 wt.% protein content, comprises less than 8 wt.% RNA content, and has been inactivated; and
b. lactic acid bacteria; wherein the yogurt analog food product is vegan.
2. The yogurt analog food product of claim 1, wherein the lactic acid bacteria are selected from at least one of Lactobacillus bulgaricus, Streptococcus thermophilus, and a combination thereof.
3. The yogurt analog food product of claim 1 or claim 2, further comprising a thickening or gelling agent.

4. The yogurt analog food product of claim 3, wherein thickening or gelling agent is selected from the group consisting of agar, starches, higher fat liquids, fat, flax seeds, xanthan gum, guar gum, psyllium husk, ground chia seed, nut or seed butters, pumpkin puree, cooked mashed yams or sweet potato, applesauce, mashed overripe bananas or plantains, pureed dates or prunes, soaked and simmered figs, shredded fruit/vegetables, shredded coconut, gluten free flours, cooked pureed beans, cocoa powder, vegetable gums, polysaccharides, vegetable mucilage, seaweed derivatives, pectin, gluten, soy and egg analogs.
5. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the size of at least 60 % of the particles is 1 µm - 10 µm.
6. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-5, further comprising an invert sugar, a rennet, a probiotic, an enzymatic water, a chickpea water, or combinations thereof.
7. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-6, wherein cells of the filamentous fungus are lysed.
8. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-7, wherein the filamentous fungus is selected from the group consisting of:
9. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-8, wherein the protein content is greater than 45 dry wt.%, the RNA content is less than 5 dry wt.%, or both.

10. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-9, wherein the filamentous fungus comprises less than 10 ppm of a mycotoxin selected from the group consisting of Aflatoxin B1, Aflatoxin B2, Aflatoxin G1, Aflatoxin G2, Fumonisin B1, Fumonisin B2, Fumonisin B3, Ochratoxin A, Nivalenol, Deoxynivalenol, Acetyl deoxynivalenol, Fusarenon X, T-2 Toxin, HT-2 Toxin, Neosolaniol, Diacetoxyscirpenol zearalenone, beauvericin, fusarin C, fusaric acid, and combinations thereof.
11. The yogurt analog food product of claim 10, wherein the filamentous fungus comprises less than 10 ppm total mycotoxin content.
12. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-11, wherein the filamentous fungus comprises greater than 15 wt.% of branched chain amino acids.
13. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-12, wherein the yogurt analog food product has the appearance and texture of yogurt.
14. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-12, wherein the yogurt analog food product has the smell and taste of yogurt.
15. The yogurt analog food product of any one of claims 1-12, wherein the yogurt analog food product has the appearance and texture of yogurt and the smell and taste of yogurt.
